sentences: Traders moved $499 million through Polymarket in the week of 2026-10-05, across 16.2 million individual trades. Algorithmic wallets accounted for 57% of weekly counterparty events (both maker and taker sides counted); everyone else split the remaining 43%.
The most-traded market was "Will Flávio Bolsonaro win the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?", pulling in $2 million of volume. Politics dominated the week's attention.
Both sides lost money on resolved trades this week. Bots dropped $515K (-158 bps); retail dropped $232K (-956 bps). Much of the activity was in markets that have not yet resolved.
headline_quote: Polymarket traders moved $499 million this week, with the biggest action on "Will Flávio Bolsonaro win the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?".
